cohort: 936 women in three hospitals in the central north of Sweden, of whom 70 received counseling due to fear of childbirth
finding: Counseling for childbirth-related fear had a minor effect on fear of childbirth, birth experiences or cesarean section rates, although women were satisfied with the treatment.
mod_finding: Women who received counseling were more often delivered by planned cesarean section (OR 4.7, 95% CI 2.4-9.1).
